target.title: fix(docs): anchor audit fails before checking links
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where developers running the Mintlify anchor audit would hit `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` for packages such as React or `openapi-types` before any documentation was checked.

## Why This Change Was Made

Runs an exact Mintlify CLI version through npm's supported hoisted execution layout, using the repository's portable npm resolver. This keeps the existing Node 22 fallback and avoids Mintlify's package graph failing under pnpm dlx's strict store layout.

AI-assisted: yes.

## User Impact

Developers can run the anchor audit and receive actual Mintlify documentation findings instead of a package-resolution crash. No product runtime behavior changes.

## Evidence

- Before: `pnpm docs:check-links:anchors` failed while importing Mintlify dependencies.
- After: the same live command launches Mintlify and reaches documentation parsing; current-main MDX content errors are now reported normally.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/scripts/docs-link-audit.test.ts` (10 tests passed)
- `pnpm docs:check-links` (6,234 links checked, 0 broken)
- Testbox changed gate passed: https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/29677174032
- Autoreview: clean, no accepted or actionable findings.
